contexts.text: They have no license to think and speak what is false, except what is from their evil...
They place freedom in the humour and license of thinking and speaking what is false, and of willing and doing what is evil.
Occurs.
It is contrary to Divine order to leave them the license of acting with simulation...
They spoke in all license...
The intelligence of men is... fond of unrestrained liberty. Explained.
The license of saying and denying...
From inborn license...
If the liberty or license of acting according to their cupidity were given them...
Societies of Spirits who want to use their license... Some (of them) are repugnant to their license...
By complying with their license...
The moment instantaneous license is given, it is restrained.
Spirits are not allowed to act from license, or their own free determination.
In the World of Spirits... license is sometimes granted them...
When license is loosened to those evil ones...
The license so to take possession of man is not permitted them.
He thus caused grievous trouble to those who wanted to live in license.
They were thus thrust out of the state of their unrestrained liberty...
They fear the loss of their life and unrestrained liberty.
Thus (comes) unbounded license against conjugial love.
He was restored to his former unrestrained liberty, and was again explored.
They did not know how everyone has unbounded liberty of thinking...
(They think) that if they detect any evil in a man, they have license to destroy him.
When they are acting licentiously together...
c. The license of doing what they want...
The license to reason from fallacies. Signified.
